text:
alex_dev: quick smoke run: prefilled 16k context on magnet-14B int8 and started seeing drift around token ~8200. sharing repro steps and logs below.

ema_ml: can you paste the exact command + model config?

alex_dev: sure. command i ran:
```
./run_prefill.sh --model magnet-14b --quant int8 --ctx 16384 --prefill-file tests/longseed.txt --rope_scale 1.0
```
also ran with --rope_scale 0.5 and noticed different drift behavior.

jin: interesting. drift as in token distribution diverges or kv mismatch?

alex_dev: divergence in tokens (sampling) but also saw mismatched kv indices in debug dumps — some keys appear shifted by small offsets near boundary.

lila: could be wrap-around when the prefix length crosses the shard boundary. did you check kv index wrap handling?

alex_dev: i dumped a few lines of the kv index debug:
```
[2026-03-20T22:01:12Z] kv_index: shard=3 slot=8199 -> key_hash=0x7f2a, idx=8198
[2026-03-20T22:01:12Z] kv_index: shard=3 slot=8200 -> key_hash=0x7f2b, idx=8200
[2026-03-20T22:01:12Z] kv_index: shard=3 slot=8201 -> key_hash=0x7f2c, idx=8199
```
looks like idx order jumps (8198,8200,8199) which smells like a race or off-by-one when compacting.

ema_ml: also try with float32 baseline (no quant) to rule out int8 rounding. did you do that?

alex_dev: yes float32 baseline is clean. int8 shows the pattern.

jin: another angle: rotary embedding scaling mismatches between prefill and inference runtime can cause perceived token drift because attention weights shift. did you confirm rope_scale used during compilation/runtime was identical?

alex_dev: i thought so but double-checking now. the build used rope_scale=1.0, but runtime config was accidentally set via env to 0.5 in the dedicated node pool. oops. that could explain it.

lila: that would explain phase misalignment. when rope_scale differs, kv keys are effectively in a different coordinate frame -> index collisions at wrap.

ops-bot: CI run #98451 finished: tests/longprefill-smoke — FAIL (see http://ci.internal/98451) :warning:

ema_ml: even if rope_scale mismatch is root, we still need a guard: detect mismatched runtime/compile rope config at startup and warn/fail.

jin: agree. add runtime assertion comparing compiled rope metadata (scale/version/hash) with env/config. lightweight check.

alex_dev: plan: 1) add runtime sanity check (rope metadata) 2) add targeted unit test for int8 + rope_scale mismatch to reproduce kv index jitter 3) run nightly bisect across quantization codepaths. who can take 1 and 2?

ema_ml: i'll take the unit test + nightly bisect orchestration (i can reuse existing infra).

lila: i'll do the runtime assertion and a quick patch to make the error clearer (link to docs).

alex_dev: thanks. i'll rerun the failing job with rope_scale fixed and post logs.

ops-bot: scheduled nightly job: longprefill-bisect starting 2026-03-21 04:00 UTC (job id 98452).

jin: small suggestion for the unit test: include a synthetic prefill that crosses multiple shards with deterministic key hashes so we can assert exact kv_index sequences. makes the regression check robust.

ema_ml: good call — i'll add deterministic seeds and attach test vectors to the eval harness.

alex_dev: posted updated clean run logs: http://ci.internal/98453 — baseline float32 pass, int8 + corrected rope_scale pass. leaving this thread open until patches land. :thumbsup:
